title: host a local application on an operator-managed Azure-consistent platform
input: The operator prepares supported Stack Hub capacity and tenant subscriptions for the local workload.
action: Stack Hub provides supported local infrastructure and Azure-consistent services within the operator-managed environment. Tenant resources run the application; the operator manages platform capacity and updates.
output: Local users access the deployed application through the site's approved network and tenant access policy.
check: Test tenant isolation, platform update procedure, local data backup and the chosen connected or disconnected operating mode.

title: apply a reviewed bulk policy to selected storage objects
input: The storage owner defines object-selection conditions and the permitted bulk action.
action: Storage Actions evaluates the configured storage task against supported objects and performs its authorized operations. Task scope and conditions must exclude unrelated or protected data before enabling a broad change.
output: The owner examines task execution results and verifies the intended object changes.
check: Run against a bounded test dataset first; check exclusions, failed operations and protected-object behavior before expansion.

title: identify storage usage and governance candidates
input: The storage owner selects the supported estate and the inventory question to investigate.
action: Storage Discovery presents supported storage inventory and insights under its configured scope. Operators use that evidence to identify ownership, usage or governance candidates; a discovered recommendation is not an automatic object deletion.
output: The resource owner validates the identified accounts or data before proposing an approved change.
check: Check inventory freshness, coverage and actual resource configuration before accepting a governance action.

title: copy a file-share dataset into Azure storage
input: The file owner inventories supported source shares, permissions and destination mapping.
action: Storage Mover uses configured agents and migration jobs to copy supported source data to the selected Azure destination. Job settings govern transfer and supported metadata behavior; final source-write coordination remains explicit.
output: The destination application reads the accepted files after the completed transfer and reconciliation.
check: Compare file counts, checksums, permissions and final delta before redirecting users to the destination.

title: validate a release using assigned manual test cases
input: The quality owner defines test cases, expected results and the release under test.
action: Test Plans organizes test suites, executions and recorded outcomes. Testers exercise the application and attach evidence; the tool's pass status records their judgment rather than executing every manual test itself.
output: The release owner reviews failed cases and acceptance evidence before allowing promotion.
check: Check requirement coverage, reproducible failures and tester permissions before accepting the release gate.

title: translate approved product text with a terminology policy
input: The content application submits authorized text, source and target language and permitted terminology settings.
action: Translator generates the supported text translation using the selected configuration. The application retains source-text context and sends regulated or high-impact content for human review before publishing.
output: The content reviewer checks terminology and publishes the accepted translated product description.
check: Test language detection, glossaries, formatting and sensitive-input retention using representative product text.

title: produce a tested enterprise VM image
input: The image maintainer defines a supported source image, customization scripts and output destinations.
action: VM Image Builder runs the configured image build using the permitted build identity and network access. Customizations install approved packages; distributed image artifacts are versioned for later VM deployment.
output: The platform deploys a test VM from the new image and promotes it only after acceptance.
check: Verify package versions, secret removal, boot behavior and rollback to the previous image version.

title: move a supported vSphere application to Azure VMware infrastructure
input: The virtualization owner inventories VMs, network segments, storage and software licensing.
action: Azure VMware Solution supplies the supported VMware private-cloud infrastructure on Azure. VMware migration tools move the application VMs; application state and connectivity require explicit cutover validation.
output: The target VM serves the application through its approved private-network and data dependencies.
check: Test VM compatibility, routing, final data synchronization, licensing and rollback before switching clients.

title: provide a controlled employee desktop session
input: The employee authenticates through the configured identity and assigned workspace or application group.
action: Virtual Desktop brokers the permitted session onto the configured session hosts. Applications execute on those hosts; host-pool, profile and network configuration determine persistence and access to corporate services.
output: The employee works with the assigned applications and protected profile storage.
check: Test assignments, concurrent sessions, profile recovery and session-host failure before broad rollout.

title: apply a reviewed connectivity configuration across VNets
input: The network owner selects network groups, intended connectivity and supported configuration scope.
action: Virtual Network Manager distributes configured supported connectivity or security administration settings across selected VNets. Effective network resources and routes carry traffic; the manager coordinates configuration rather than processing requests.
output: The network team verifies the applied topology and tests the intended application connection.
check: Check group membership, effective routes, denied paths and staged rollback before expanding the configuration.
